blocks.prompt: 8 (i) Consider the function \(f(x) = 3x - 5\). Determine the domain and range of \(f(x)\).
blocks.explanation:
\(f(x) = 3x - 5\) ek seedhi line hai (sab se bari power 1).
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = 3x - 5\).
Find kya karna hai? Domain aur range.
Plan: na root hai na fraction, is liye domain saare real numbers; range ke liye \(y = 3x - 5\) ko \(x\) ke liye solve karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x - 5\).
Humein find karna hai: domain aur range.
Tareeqa: Pehle dekhenge koi root ya fraction to nahi; phir dikhayenge ke har \(y\) ka koi input mojood hai.

Domain
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty, \infty)\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi real number ko 3 se multiply kar ke 5 minus kar sakte hain. Koi rukawat nahi.

Range
\[y = 3x - 5 \Rightarrow x = \dfrac{y + 5}{3}\]
\[\text{Range } f = (-\infty, \infty)\]
Kyun: 5 ko doosri taraf jama kiya aur 3 se divide kiya. Har real \(y\) ke liye yeh \(x\) real hai (neeche 3 hai jo kabhi zero nahi), is liye har \(y\) output ban sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 1:\; x = 2,\ f(2) = 6 - 5 = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Output 1 chuna, input 2 mila, aur \(f(2)\) waqai 1 hai.

blocks.prompt: 8 (ii) Consider the function \(f(x) = 3x - 5\). Is the function \(f\) one-to-one? Justify your answer.
blocks.explanation:
One-to-one (ek ke badle ek) ka matlab: do alag inputs kabhi ek hi output nahi dete. Doosre lafzon mein, agar outputs barabar hon to inputs bhi barabar hon.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = 3x - 5\).
Find kya karna hai? Kya \(f\) one-to-one hai, aur daleel (justification).
Plan: \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) maan kar dikhana ke \(x_1 = x_2\) hi banta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x - 5\).
Humein saabit karna hai: \(f(x_1) = f(x_2) \Rightarrow x_1 = x_2\).
Tareeqa: One-to-one ki definition seedhi lagayenge. Sirf misaalein dena kaafi nahi, kyunke har mumkin jore ke liye saabit karna hai; is liye letters \(x_1, x_2\) istemal karte hain.

Do outputs barabar maanein
\[f(x_1) = f(x_2)\]
\[3x_1 - 5 = 3x_2 - 5\]
Kyun: Domain se koi bhi do inputs liye jin ka output ek jaisa hai, aur rule likh diya.

Simplify karein
\[3x_1 = 3x_2\]
\[x_1 = x_2\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 5 jama kiya, phir 3 se divide kiya. Har qadam ulta bhi chal sakta hai, is liye koi maloomat zaya nahi hui.

Nateeja
Kyun: Barabar outputs se barabar inputs nikle, yani do alag inputs kabhi ek output share nahi karte. Misaal: \(f(1) = -2\) aur \(f(2) = 1\), alag alag. Graph par bhi: koi horizontal line is seedhi line ko ek se zyada jagah nahi kaat'ti.
blocks.final_answer: Haan, \(f\) one-to-one hai, kyunke \(f(x_1) = f(x_2) \Rightarrow x_1 = x_2\) (barabar outputs se barabar inputs).

blocks.prompt: 8 (iii) Consider the function \(f(x) = 3x - 5\). Is the function \(f\) onto if the co-domain is all real numbers? Explain.
blocks.explanation:
Onto ka matlab: co-domain (jahan outputs ko aana chahiye) ka har number waqai kisi input ka output ho.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = 3x - 5\), co-domain saare real numbers.
Find kya karna hai? Kya har real \(y\) ka koi pre-image (input) hai.
Plan: koi bhi real \(y\) le kar \(x\) nikalna, phir check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x - 5\), co-domain \(\mathbb{R}\).
Humein saabit karna hai: har \(y \in \mathbb{R}\) ka pre-image hai.
Tareeqa: \(3x - 5 = y\) ko \(x\) ke liye solve karenge aur wapas rakh kar check karenge.

Har \(y\) ka input nikalein
\[3x - 5 = y\]
\[x = \dfrac{y + 5}{3}\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi real \(y\) ke liye yeh \(x\) real hai aur domain (saare real numbers) mein hai.

Tasdeeq: kya yeh input sahi output deta hai?
\[f\left(\dfrac{y + 5}{3}\right) = 3 \cdot \dfrac{y + 5}{3} - 5\]
\[= y + 5 - 5 = y \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 3 aur 3 cancel hue, phir 5 aur \(-5\). Output wohi \(y\) aaya. Yani range poora co-domain hai, aur function onto hai. Part (ii) ke saath mila kar \(f\) bijective (one-to-one aur onto dono) hai.
Dhyan dein: "Onto" ka jawab hamesha co-domain par munhasir hai; agar co-domain kuch aur hota to jawab badal sakta tha.
blocks.final_answer: Haan, \(f\) onto \(\mathbb{R}\) hai: har real \(y\) input \(x = \frac{y + 5}{3}\) ka output hai. (Part (ii) ke saath \(f\) bijective hai.)
